summary: PO 2025 section 7: compulsory modules, one EE specialization (30 ECTS) plus at least 6 ECTS electives from the cross-specialization catalogue (36 ECTS together), a 12-ECTS project in FB16, and Integrated Sustainability Studies B (30 ECTS: the two basic modules plus one 18-ECTS sustainability specialization not offered by FB16, per AB NaS section 8(2)).

categories.name: Elective modules
categories.note: At least 6 ECTS from the cross-specialization catalogue: listed electives, or specialization modules of a specialization other than your own (§ 7 Abs. 4). A module that fills the chosen EE specialization does not also fill this slot. Two small 3-4 ECTS labs may be needed. Individually approved modules are outside this check.

categories.name: Learning and organization
categories.note: Compulsory 2-ECTS part of the 7-ECTS key competencies from the interdisciplinary offering (§ 7 Abs. 9).

categories.name: Key competencies (electives)
categories.note: Remaining 5 ECTS of the interdisciplinary key competencies (§ 7 Abs. 9).

categories.name: Sustainability studies: basic modules
categories.note: Both basic modules are required: Grundlagen und Theorien der Nachhaltigkeit (6 ECTS) and Erkenntnistheorie und Methoden der Nachhaltigkeit (6 ECTS). Only the first is offered this semester.

categories.name: One specialization of your choice
categories.note: 30 ECTS in the one chosen EE specialization (§ 7 Abs. 3). The study plan assigns the modules; this semester every specialization is still short of 30 ECTS.

categories.name: One sustainability specialization
categories.note: 18 ECTS as one AB NaS specialization bundle (30 ECTS INS B minus the two 6-ECTS basic modules), not a free mix and not three modules in every specialization. Schwerpunkte 6 and 19: choose three 6-credit modules. Schwerpunkt 29: choose two 9-credit modules. a/b modules: take one of the pair. Where this semester offers less than 18 ECTS, take every offered module of that bundle.
